guard: Every selected fixture executes on one configured shard; the aggregate changed check rejects failure, cancellation and skipping. Every child launched by the smoke excludes inherited COTAL_ variables, and an empty shard reports only its own assignment.

mutations.name: every shard executes the full selected set
mutations.find: if (shard) selected = selected.filter(({ path }) => mutationShard(path, Number(shard[2])) === Number(shard[1]));
mutations.replace: if (false && shard) selected = selected.filter(({ path }) => mutationShard(path, Number(shard[2])) === Number(shard[1]));
mutations.expectRed: fixture shards partition the selected set without omission or overlap
mutations.cell: fixture shards partition the selected set without omission or overlap

mutations.name: all fixtures collapse onto shard zero
mutations.expectRed: the partition control exercises every configured shard with a discriminating fixture
mutations.cell: the partition control exercises every configured shard with a discriminating fixture

mutations.name: the workflow omits the runner shard argument
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: the matrix is hardcoded instead of read from the plan
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: a failed shard cancels its sibling work
mutations.find:
changed_shard:
    # At dfbb4550f, PR #1350 selected 32 fixtures and exhausted the 145-minute serial step.
    # Each path is assigned to one shard by the runner's existing hash. Shards use separate
    # checkouts because mutation-proof temporarily changes source and compiled artifacts.
    # Only the shards the plan named are fanned; the shard run re-selects for itself, so a shard
    # that disagrees with the plan prints its own selection rather than trusting the plan's.
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && needs.plan.outputs.shards != '[]'
    needs: [plan]
    timeout-minutes: 150
    runs-on: tenki-standard-medium-4c-8g
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
mutations.replace:
changed_shard:
    # At dfbb4550f, PR #1350 selected 32 fixtures and exhausted the 145-minute serial step.
    # Each path is assigned to one shard by the runner's existing hash. Shards use separate
    # checkouts because mutation-proof temporarily changes source and compiled artifacts.
    # Only the shards the plan named are fanned; the shard run re-selects for itself, so a shard
    # that disagrees with the plan prints its own selection rather than trusting the plan's.
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && needs.plan.outputs.shards != '[]'
    needs: [plan]
    timeout-minutes: 150
    runs-on: tenki-standard-medium-4c-8g
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload fans exactly the planned shards without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: the aggregate is skipped after a shard fails
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate changed check waits for the plan and every shard even after a failed or cancelled shard
mutations.cell: the aggregate changed check waits for the plan and every shard even after a failed or cancelled shard

mutations.name: the aggregate no longer waits on the matrix

mutations.name: the aggregate accepts failed shards
mutations.find: if [ "$PLAN_SHARDS" = "[]" ]; then test "$SHARD_RESULT" = skipped; else test "$SHARD_RESULT" = success; fi
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate shell rejects plan=success shards=[0,3] matrix=failure
mutations.cell: the aggregate shell rejects plan=success shards=[0,3] matrix=failure

mutations.name: the aggregate accepts cancellation
mutations.find: if [ "$PLAN_SHARDS" = "[]" ]; then test "$SHARD_RESULT" = skipped; else test "$SHARD_RESULT" = success; fi
mutations.replace: if [ "$PLAN_SHARDS" = "[]" ]; then test "$SHARD_RESULT" = skipped; else test "$SHARD_RESULT" != failure; fi
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate shell rejects plan=success shards=[0,3] matrix=cancelled
